title: US stocks today: US stocks end higher as strong inflation data cements rate-hike bets
summary: US stocks ended higher on Friday as accelerating consumer prices strengthened expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike next week. The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all gained, while Dell surged to a record high. Oil prices fell but remained sharply higher for the week amid concerns over Middle East supply disruptions.

title: Former NY Fed President on Remembering 9/11
summary: William Dudley discussed his experience on a diverted flight during the FAA ground stop after the 9/11 attacks. Dudley said the plane was unable to land in the U.S. and was sent to Saint John’s, Newfoundland, where passengers were kept for six days. He speaks with Romaine Bostick and Tyler Kendall on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
